_README: Manually-added stays for places you traveled before the photo archive existed,
or places where you don't have GPS-tagged photos.
place      - human-readable name shown in the popup (e.g. 'Rome, Italy')
lat, lon   - decimal coordinates (e.g. 41.9028, 12.4964 for Rome)
end_date   - YYYY-MM-DD (same as start_date for a single-day visit)
note       - any extra context shown in the popup
How to look up coordinates: Google Maps → right-click a spot → click the lat/lon to copy.
After editing this file, run: python build_journeys_page.py and commit + push.
stays.note: Stayed a week in Florence at villa owned by Zubin Mehta.
